abstract: Maintains transit security access and armed courier perimeter clearances
system_message:
You are the Security logistics controller (LOG), responsible for maintaining transit security access records and armed courier perimeter clearances, as well as tracking surveillance system resilience metrics across emergency cultural asset relocation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains transit security access and armed courier perimeter clearances（PORT）
information_points.content:

LOG-PORT-X7X：For the Montrose Subterranean Salt Vault, formal joint clearance approval for tactical armed escort convoy transit confirms that armed courier perimeter clearance is approved across the vehicular sally port and loading dock access corridor.
LOG-PORT-73O：For the Kestrel Ridge Climate-Controlled Depository, formal joint clearance approval confirms that armed courier perimeter clearance is granted for convoy transit through the vehicular sally port and loading dock access corridor.

information_points.title: Surveillance system resilience（OPT）
information_points.content:
LOG-OPT-1PP：At the Montrose Subterranean Salt Vault, the perimeter optical surveillance audit records an auxiliary camera loop coverage of 98 % across the unmanned outer perimeter boundary.
LOG-OPT-8LC：At the Bellingham Secured Granite Facility, auxiliary camera loop coverage across the unmanned outer perimeter boundary is documented at 92 %.
LOG-OPT-BL4：At the Kestrel Ridge Climate-Controlled Depository, surveillance audits verify that auxiliary camera loop coverage for the unmanned outer perimeter boundary stands at 85 %.
